column1: # BestPath Slayer places added by hand (owner 2026-10-19): places the generated data/wiki/slayer-places.tsv lacks, in the
# same columns. Read by the plugin export (gradlew -p tool exportPlugin, tool/.../slayer/SlayerExport) after the Wiki's
# places, then put on the map the same way. DEVELOPMENT-TIME data from the OSRS Wiki, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0
# (data/wiki/LICENSE-WIKI.txt): page / revision = the page that says these monsters count for the task, tile_pages = the
# monster pages ({{LocLine}} spawns, read from the saved pages in cache/wiki/slayer, no new requests) the tiles come from;
# amount = how many spawns those pages list.
# Spiders in the Wilderness (owner 2026-10-19, in-game test: "we need to make sure crystillia slayer master functions
# properly for wilderness tasks", then "add everything"): the Spiders task page (rev 15250979) lists every spider kind as
# counting but its location table has no Wilderness place, so Krystilia's spider task had no place to go.

column4: Spider Hill (north of the Lava Dragon Isle)
column15: The Wiki's tip for Krystilia's spider tasks: aggressive spiders with little hitpoints around a sapphire spawn, about level 46 Wilderness; a cannon works well.

column4: West of the Wilderness Bandit Camp

column15: Venenatis, a boss; kills count for a spider task (Wiki Slayer task/Spiders).

column1: # Monsters that count for a task but have no place in the task page's location table (owner 2026-10-19, asked about
# special loot: "Add their places too"): one place per {{LocLine}} location of the monster's page (read from the saved
# pages in cache/wiki/slayer, no new requests; page / revision = the monster page, whose {{HasTask}} says it counts),
# amount = its spawns there. Left out: bosses, superiors (they appear anywhere on task), places a task already has
# (cow calves in the cow fields, metal dragons in Brimhaven and the Catacombs, shades in the Shade Catacombs, ...),
# Mogre (sea) (at sea), Scorpia's offspring (in a boss's cave), Scarab Swarm (no spawns). Barrows tunnel(s): one place.
